scripts.build: npm run format && npm run assets && npm run pio
scripts.format: npm run format:cpp && npm run format:web
scripts.format:web: prettier --write 'src/**/*.{js,json,css,html}' platformio.ini package.json README.md vite.config.mjs tailwind.config.js
scripts.format:cpp: command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1 && find src -iname '*.h' -o -iname '*.cpp' -o -iname '*.ino' | xargs clang-format -i || echo 'clang-format not found, skipping format:cpp'
scripts.pio: npm run pio:firmware && sleep 2 && npm run pio:filesystem
scripts.build:esp1: npm run format && npm run assets && pio run -e esp_1 -t upload && pio run -e esp_1 -t uploadfs
scripts.build:esp2: npm run format && npm run assets && pio run -e esp_2 -t upload && pio run -e esp_2 -t uploadfs
scripts.build:esp3: npm run format && npm run assets && pio run -e esp_3 -t upload && pio run -e esp_3 -t uploadfs
scripts.build:esp4: npm run format && npm run assets && pio run -e esp_4 -t upload && pio run -e esp_4 -t uploadfs
scripts.build-monitor:esp1: npm run build:esp1 && npm run monitor:esp1
scripts.build-monitor:esp2: npm run build:esp2 && npm run monitor:esp2
scripts.build-monitor:esp3: npm run build:esp3 && npm run monitor:esp3
scripts.build-monitor:esp4: npm run build:esp4 && npm run monitor:esp4
